raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "bio-embeddings-deepblast" %}
{% set version = "0.1.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/bio-embeddings-deepblast-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 26c1c18b405eeea57ad20d1d4c39c35dc40c9706705662a0af188523757bfae7

build:
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  number: 1
  noarch: python

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - poetry >=1.1.0
  run:
    - matplotlib-base
    - numba
    - numpy
    - pandas
    - pillow
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - pytorch-lightning >=0.8.1
    - scikit-learn
    - scipy
    - pytorch >=1.4

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - deepblast

about:
  home: https://pypi.org/project/bio-embeddings-deepblast/
  summary: Deep Sequence Alignments.
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - hadim
